description: Traffic Counts: Cordon Count, Quays Count DCC is a dataset listed in Ireland national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Dublin City Council. Every November Dublin City Council (DCC) conducts traffic counts at 33 locations on entry points into the city centre around a 'cordon' formed by the Royal and Grand Canals. Coverage: Dublin City Council. The portal files it under the publisher Dublin City Council. Its tags are Transport and Infrastructure, cycling, pedestrian-footfall, traffic-counts, traffic-volumes. It offers 18 resource(s) in CSV, GEOJSON, PDF, POWERPOINT, ZIP. The portal shows 2026-09-22 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ie-portal.
